limitation: Partial fornix system includes a source-traced left fimbria continuation into the left crus. The right fimbria, complete left fimbria and mammillary continuity remain incomplete. Approximate boundaries; not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: HarP attachment/direction criteria and Gonzalez-Arnay 2024 Fig. 1 support the manually traced dorsomedial hippocampal band and its turn into the crus. Native100 Y600..700 source and orthogonal views, followed by five final app-grid footprints, support 653 left additions. Fifty-two existing ID46 cells are unchanged; three near-white cavity-centre flags are excluded. Brightness is an exclusion flag within the anatomical trace, not a classifier. No bridge is drawn through the adjacent fissure. This is a teaching-scale partial fimbria, not its complete extent.
